own_gpu_only.caps: Power caps need root on the GPU; hosted platforms give none.
own_gpu_only.quant: Quantization needs our own deployment of the model; not possible on a shared endpoint.
own_gpu_only.topk: Adaptive top-k / tiered experts change the model's router; needs our own deployment.

tokens_saved.label: ESTIMATE
tokens_saved.method: scaled up to 1k answers from n=15 calls per arm

j_per_token.label: ESTIMATE
j_per_token.method: H100 0.1497 J/token (RUN2, MEASURED) x 42B/0.8B active params

estimate.basis: per 1k answers (routing) plus the agent tasks (waste)

wh_per_1k.label: ESTIMATE
wh_per_1k.method: 2 x active params x (uncached prompt + completion tokens) FLOPs, times a J/FLOP range for H100-class GPUs. Cached prompt tokens skip prefill. Not measured on Baseten's GPUs.
